name: cortex
description: Relative Cortex orchestration for reliable staged agent work with durable internal audit state.

interface.shortDescription: Coordinate staged work across Codex agents
interface.longDescription: Adds 21 bundled agent profiles, 10 skills, and three narrow Cortex v3 tools over the local Cortex v7 ledger. Luna coordinators start once, continue by relative step and worker slot, and use a separate management path for recovery while Cortex preserves receipt-backed reports, gates, verification, and handoff state.
interface.defaultPrompt: Coordinate this task with Cortex. Use help, harvest, or harvest-refresh when that exact route is requested.
